acceptance_criteria: Read exactly the first 2048 validation frames for each frozen M1 seed on CPU and CUDA; training, C10 and M-TARE reads are zero.
Use the unchanged +12-column (6 degree) rotation and every-10th-column mask with normalized range=1 and valid=0; frozen thresholds remain 2e-5, 0.999 and 0.85.
Report mean, p05, p95, minimum and maximum distributions per seed/device plus explicit rotation and masking attribution.
Create no gradients, optimizer steps, weight updates or checkpoints and make no data, model, graph or planner changes.
Complete within 900 seconds and 50MiB with metrics, one CPU/CUDA comparison figure, logs, environment identity, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
baseline: The sealed v1r3 formal CUDA stability metric: rotation maximum absolute logit error about 0.00499 versus 2e-5, rotation z_role cosine about 1.0, and fixed masking median mean cosine 0.205687 versus 0.85.

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only CPU and RTX 5090 D inference over three frozen checkpoints and 2048 validation frames; no backward, optimizer, training, checkpoint creation, C10 or M-TARE.

expected_evidence: Per-seed CPU/CUDA stability distributions and aggregate scientific attribution.
One comparison figure showing rotation maximum error and masking mean cosine against frozen thresholds.
Frozen proposal/spec/source identities, raw log, environment probe, RUN_STATE and complete SHA-256 seal.
method: Run no-gradient CPU and CUDA inference for frozen M1 seeds 0/1/2 on the identical first 2048 V2R validation frames, comparing base input with a +12-column circular rotation and the unchanged every-10th-column v1r3 mask. Report distributions and device attribution without changing weights, checkpoints, thresholds, data, split, network, heads, loss, graph, or planner.
question: Is the v1r3 rotation maximum-error failure a CUDA numerical metric-contract artifact while the fixed 10% ray-column masking failure is device-independent model/input fragility?

Any training, strict-test, M-TARE, graph or planner read/change would occur.
